entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Query precompiler fails to lift a double branch in a target-typed nullable conditional #39304
  • Query precompiler rejects an integer zero implicitly converted to decimal in a projection #39303
  • Query precompiler rejects required-member DTO initializer because its constructor translates to an invocation #39302
  • Compiled model writes `NullableValueComparer<TComparer>` (CS0453) for a struct's ValueComparer applied to a nullable property #39291
    12.0.0
  • Azure SQL: JSON_VALUE RETURNING fails when OPENJSON projects nested JSON as nvarchar(max) #39277
    10.0.16
  • MinBy/MaxBy lowering does not skip null keys as LINQ-to-Objects does #39276
    Backlog
  • EF Tasks package docs and startup validation still recommend removed EFStartupProject property #39275
    12.0-preview1
  • Query precompiler throws Non-IQueryable first parameter for ThenInclude #39274
    12.0-preview1
  • Query precompiler rejects class constant as unknown identifier in predicate #39273
    12.0-preview1
  • Query precompiler throws parameter-evaluation NRE for captured object properties #39272
  • Query precompilation throws EvaluateOperand NullReferenceException for scalar ExecuteUpdate value setter #39271

Closed

  • # Bug report: `dotnet ef migrations add` generates incorrect `RenameColumn` for an `[Owned]`-discovered owned type the moment any of its properties is touched via `OwnsOne()` #39158
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: BeginTransaction(deferred: false) sometimes throws "cannot start a transaction within a transaction" under contention and leaves the transaction open #39238
  • Concat on string property Error #33061
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39301
  • Fix Azure SQL JSON_VALUE RETURNING over nested OPENJSON projections #39299
  • Support unqualified class constants in query precompilation #39298
  • Fix query precompiler rejecting ThenInclude sources #39297
  • Correct EF Tasks startup guidance and diagnostics #39296
  • [release/11.0] Fix FromSql queries with JSON-mapped complex properties #39295
  • Fix SQL Server split-query projections of primitive JSON collections #39294
  • Fix connection cancellation notifications to interceptors #39293
  • Fix nullable value comparer type arguments in compiled models #39292
  • Validate and uniquify complex-property column names #39290
    area-harness
  • Fix harness evaluation result discovery #39289
  • [release/11.0] Preserve null results from primitive collection element converters #39288
  • Move relational model mapping equality into metadata types #39287
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39279
  • feat: add per-query command timeout #39278
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Preserve inherited complex-property column prefixes in TPC mappings #39270

Merged

  • Bump actions/setup-node from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 #39281
    area-infrastructure, area-harness
  • Bump actions/upload-artifact from 7.0.1 to 7.0.2 #39282
    area-infrastructure, area-harness
  • Make the evals more realistic and improve the skills accordingly #39217
    area-harness
  • [release/10.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 9.0.20 to 9.0.21 #39267
    area-infrastructure
  • Bump actions/download-artifact from 8.0.1 to 8.0.2 #39280
    area-infrastructure
  • Fix Not on bool? and Increment/Decrement on non-int types in LinqToCSharpSyntaxTranslator #39230
    community-contribution
  • Keep fractional seconds in SQL Server TimeSpan literals #39229
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 9.0.20 to 9.0.21 #39283
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26509.3 to 11.0.0-beta.26514.118 #39284
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump System.CommandLine from 2.0.12 to 2.0.13 #39285
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Testcontainers.CosmosDb from 4.15.0 to 4.16.0 #39286
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39268
  • Fix select concat #39269
    community-contribution
